verdict.rationale: macOS is an operating system, so running it headlessly or in CI is a fair question. The evidence only glancingly touches it: community reports show built-in command-line utilities (pbcopy/pbpaste, qlmanage, hidutil, networkQuality) used in scriptable pipelines without the GUI, and Apple documents task automation through Shortcuts. None of it addresses headless operation of the OS or CI-runner use. Missing for 10: first-party docs on headless/no-display operation, CI runner or remote/SSH automation guidance, a scriptable Shortcuts CLI, and independent hands-on CI evidence.
